headline: Clean up your Mac menu bar with elegance.
优雅整理与折叠 Mac 菜单栏图标。
features: 3-tier organization: Always Visible, Auto Hide, and Always Hidden
三阶分级收纳：常驻、折叠、隐藏
Silky hover & click activation with notch collision protection
丝滑悬停/点击唤起与刘海屏防遮挡保护
100% Zero-Permission & Local-First, privacy-friendly with zero network requests
100% 零系统权限与本地优先，无网络请求保护绝对隐私
limits: Compatible with macOS 12.0 or later. Zero-Permission architecture — runs safely in sandbox without requiring Accessibility or screen recording permissions.
兼容 macOS 12.0 或更高版本。纯净零系统权限架构，无需辅助功能与屏幕录制权限，沙盒安全即开即用。

headline: Control one app’s sound.
单独调整一个应用的声音。
features: Independent volume from 0% to 100%
0%–100% 独立音量调节
App mute and live audio indicators
应用静音与实时发声指示
System output selection in the same panel
在同一面板选择系统输出设备
Per-app output selection and scenes that remember each app’s device
按应用选择输出设备，场景可记住各应用的设备
limits: Requires system-audio capture permission. Protected audio and some routing or devices may not work. Controls apps, not browser tabs; no amplification above 100%.
需要系统音频捕获权限。受保护音频、部分路由或设备可能不兼容。按应用而非浏览器标签页控制；不支持超过 100% 放大。

headline: Understand your connection.
看清网络连接的问题。
features: Wi-Fi, Ethernet, DNS and route information
Wi-Fi、以太网、DNS 与路由信息
Internet reachability and local diagnostic history
互联网连通性与本地诊断时间线
Export a redacted support package yourself
主动导出脱敏支持包
limits: Read-only diagnostics, not automatic repair or a VPN service. Connectivity tests contact public endpoints. Results describe the sampled connection and do not guarantee that every service is reachable.
仅提供只读诊断，不是自动修复或 VPN 服务。连通性测试会访问公开端点；结果反映采样情况，不保证所有服务均可访问。

headline: Keep your work links together.
把工作入口放在一起。
features: Group and search your work links
分组整理和搜索工作链接
Open recent and featured links from the menu bar
从菜单栏打开最近和精选链接
Import configuration and back up your workspace
导入配置与备份工作空间
limits: Opens links in your default browser. HTTPS reachability checks run when requested. This is a link launcher, not a cloud sync or team collaboration service.
链接交给默认浏览器打开，HTTPS 连通性检查由用户主动发起。这是链接启动工具，不是云同步或团队协作服务。

headline: Keep every minute of your talk under control.
专为演讲者打造的分章节议程规划、排练复盘与演示流程台。
features: Section agenda planning and live countdown pacing
分章节议程规划与实时倒计时节奏把控
Per-second rehearsal review and history tracking
秒级排练复盘与演说历史趋势
Floating HUD teleprompter and presentation remote
悬浮提示窗与便携遥控辅助
limits: Native macOS runbook companion. Does not edit PowerPoint/Keynote slide content directly.
原生 macOS 演说助手工具，不直接修改 PowerPoint/Keynote 幻灯片文件本身。

headline: Turn recordings into polished videos and step-by-step guides.
电影级平滑运镜录屏与分步教程工坊。
features: Smooth automatic zoom and pan around clicks
智能平滑变焦运镜与光标柔化
Auto-generated step-by-step tutorial guide packages
一键导出分步图文教程资料包 (Markdown + HTML)
100% local processing with no cloud dependencies
100% 本地处理，无云端依赖与数据泄露隐患
limits: Requires macOS 14.0 or later and screen recording permissions. Direct download and licensing provided via official website.
需要 macOS 14.0 或更高版本及屏幕录制权限。通过官网直销提供下载与授权。
